entries.title: Exodus 34:1
segments: ¶And the LORD said to Moses, "Cut two tablets of stone like the first [ones], and I will write on [these] tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke.

entries.title: Exodus 34:2
segments: "So be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself to Me there on the top of the mountain.

entries.title: Exodus 34:3
segments: "And no man shall come up with you, and let no man be seen throughout all the mountain; let neither flocks nor herds feed before that mountain."

entries.title: Exodus 34:4
segments: So he cut two tablets of stone like the first [ones]. Then Moses rose early in the morning and went up Mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him; and he took in his hand the two tablets of stone.

entries.title: Exodus 34:5
segments: ¶Now the LORD descended in the cloud and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD.

entries.title: Exodus 34:6
segments: And the LORD passed before him and proclaimed, "The LORD, the LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abounding in goodness and truth,

entries.title: Exodus 34:7
segments: "keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, by no means clearing [the guilty], visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children and the children's children to the third and the fourth generation."

entries.title: Exodus 34:8
segments: So Moses made haste and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.

entries.title: Exodus 34:9
segments: Then he said, "If now I have found grace in Your sight, O Lord, let my Lord, I pray, go among us, even though we [are] a stiff-necked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us as Your inheritance."

entries.title: Exodus 34:10
segments: ¶And He said: "Behold, I make a covenant. Before all your people I will do marvels such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among whom you [ are] shall see the work of the LORD. For it [is] an awesome thing that I will do with you.

entries.title: Exodus 34:11
segments: "Observe what I command you this day. Behold, I am driving out from before you the Amorite and the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite.

entries.title: Exodus 34:12
segments: "Take heed to yourself, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you are going, lest it be a snare in your midst.

entries.title: Exodus 34:13
segments: "But you shall destroy their altars, break their [sacred] pillars, and cut down their [wooden] images

entries.title: Exodus 34:14
segments: '(for you shall worship no other god, for the LORD, whose name [is] Jealous, [is] a jealous God),

entries.title: Exodus 34:15
segments: "lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they play the harlot with their gods and make sacrifice to their gods, and [one of them] invites you and you eat of his sacrifice,

entries.title: Exodus 34:16
segments: "and you take of his daughters for your sons, and his daughters play the harlot with their gods and make your sons play the harlot with their gods.

entries.title: Exodus 34:17
segments: "You shall make no molded gods for yourselves.

entries.title: Exodus 34:18
segments: ¶"The Feast of Unleavened Bread you shall keep. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, in the appointed time of the month of Abib; for in the month of Abib you came out from Egypt.

entries.title: Exodus 34:19
segments: "All that open the womb [are] Mine, and every male firstborn among your livestock, [whether] ox or sheep.

entries.title: Exodus 34:20
segments: "But the firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb. And if you will not redeem [him], then you shall break his neck. All the firstborn of your sons you shall redeem. And none shall appear before Me empty-handed.

entries.title: Exodus 34:21
segments: "Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest; in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest.

entries.title: Exodus 34:22
segments: "And you shall observe the Feast of Weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the Feast of Ingathering at the year's end.

entries.title: Exodus 34:23
segments: "Three times in the year all your men shall appear before the Lord, the LORD God of Israel.

entries.title: Exodus 34:24
segments: "For I will cast out the nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither will any man covet your land when you go up to appear before the LORD your God three times in the year.

entries.title: Exodus 34:25
segments: "You shall not offer the blood of My sacrifice with leaven, nor shall the sacrifice of the Feast of the Passover be left until morning.

entries.title: Exodus 34:26
segments: "The first of the firstfruits of your land you shall bring to the house of the LORD your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother's milk."

entries.title: Exodus 34:27
segments: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Write these words, for according to the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel."

entries.title: Exodus 34:28
segments: ¶So he was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread nor drank water. And He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the Ten Commandments.

entries.title: Exodus 34:29
segments: Now it was so, when Moses came down from Mount Sinai (and the two tablets of the Testimony [were] in Moses' hand when he came down from the mountain), that Moses did not know that the skin of his face shone while he talked with Him.

entries.title: Exodus 34:30
segments: So when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone, and they were afraid to come near him.

entries.title: Exodus 34:31
segments: Then Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him; and Moses talked with them.

entries.title: Exodus 34:32
segments: Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them as commandments all that the LORD had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.

entries.title: Exodus 34:33
segments: And when Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.

entries.title: Exodus 34:34
segments: But whenever Moses went in before the LORD to speak with Him, he would take the veil off until he came out; and he would come out and speak to the children of Israel whatever he had been commanded.

entries.title: Exodus 34:35
segments: And whenever the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face shone, then Moses would put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with Him.
